subject: Your Friday 5: dog things for this weekend · The OC Pack
headline: 5 dog things to do in Orange County this weekend.
intro: Morning, pack. Cooler air, empty trails, and one very good beach window on Saturday. Here are the five we'd pick:

picks.name: Huntington Dog Beach
picks.detail: Off-leash along the surf. Go before 10 for easy parking off Goldenwest.

picks.name: Central Bark, Irvine
picks.detail: Three fenced acres by the Great Park. Small-dog side if your pup likes it calm.

picks.name: Newport Back Bay
picks.detail: Leashed sunrise loop, flat and stroller-friendly. Herons included at no charge.

picks.name: Santiago Oaks, Orange
picks.detail: Shaded canyon trails under the oaks. Leash on, water in the pack, ticks checked after.

picks.name: Main Beach boardwalk, Laguna
picks.detail: Leashed sunset stroll and people-watching. Check the seasonal beach hours before you go.

trailGuide.name: Top of the World, Laguna Beach
trailGuide.parking: Alta Laguna lot, fills by 10 on weekends
trailGuide.note: Ocean on one side, canyon on the other.

vetPlaybook.title: What a dental cleaning actually runs in OC
vetPlaybook.detail: The range is wider than you'd guess, and three questions before you book can cut it in half.

episode.title: Three Acres of Freedom, Inside Irvine Central Bark
